decisions.reason: The valve and flow-control change does not alter the separate leak-containment attributes; the source message's bowl-sealing requirement is already captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The dispensing-control change does not alter the sanitary-fluid-path state; the source message's removable-or-flushable cleaning method is already captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Specifying an open/close valve and controlled flow does not change the spout's bottom location, barista-facing orientation, or selected design reference.
The word 'simple' describes the requested valve mechanism and does not modify the general V1 sourcing policy or prototype-priority requirement.
Valve and flow-control details do not affect the machine's green accent color.
The dispensing-control decision does not change the display name or machine wording.
The functional valve and flow specifications do not modify the DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The source specifies dispensing behavior and bottom sealing but does not change bowl capacity or the deep-well form.
A controlled dispensing stream is distinct from the requirement to minimize splashing during mixing, whose state remains unchanged.
The detailed valve and flow requirements constrain the product design but do not change the existence, scope, or stated direction of the system-layout and CAD deliverable.
